description: This source file defines a set of command-line interface (CLI) commands for managing a launchd agent on macOS. It includes commands to install, uninstall, and check the status of the service, utilizing the Commander framework and handling plist file creation and removal.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Main entry point for the 'service' command, which groups subcommands for managing launchd agents.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Implements the 'install' subcommand to set up the launch agent plist and load it.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Implements the 'uninstall' subcommand to remove the launch agent plist.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Implements the 'status' subcommand to display whether the launch agent plist isPresent.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launch agent plist file with specified executable path.

methods.name: removePlist
methods.description: Removes the plist file for the launch agent.
